ValidationRule.description: Assignee email must be lowercase, contain exactly one '@' (CHR(64)), and its local part may not be longer than 40 characters.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Assignee_Email__c)), OR( Assignee_Email__c <> LOWER(Assignee_Email__c), LEN(Assignee_Email__c) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Assignee_Email__c, CHR(64), '')) <> 1, FIND(CHR(64), Assignee_Email__c) > 41 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assignee Email must be lowercase with a single @ and a short local part.
